items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: I still study, trying to find out what's going on, along with Beethoven and Mozart

ctx.x: The two of them had been my guiding lights. I still study, trying to

find out what's going on, along with Beethoven and Mozart; they never pay off. Some of the others do, but not those. Prokofiev is another one that stays there with me, and a lot of people don't think so, but I do. Debussy.
